schema.text: Progression-free survival.

eligibility: Age >= 18 years; ECOG performance status 0-2.
Pathologically confirmed non-squamous NSCLC, stage IV, stage IIIB not amenable to definitive multimodality therapy, or recurrent after stage I-III (AJCC 8th edition).
Sensitizing EGFR mutation (exon 19 deletion, L858R, G719X, L861Q, S768I, and others) by any CLIA-certified assay on plasma, cytology, or tissue; exon 20 insertions not eligible.
No prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease, no prior EGFR TKI, and no prior anti-VEGF agent; osimertinib started within 21 days before randomization allowed if baseline imaging preceded it.
Measurable disease with baseline imaging within 4 weeks before randomization; previously irradiated lesions without growth, or lesions irradiated after baseline imaging, cannot be target lesions.
Prior RT allowed: limited-field (stereotactic or conventional) completed at least 1 week and extensive-field (e.g., WBRT) at least 2 weeks before study drug.
No anti-VEGF risk factors: hemoptysis, active cardiovascular disease, uncontrolled hypertension, significant proteinuria (urinalysis > 300 mg/dL), or tumor invading major blood vessels.

Treated brain metastases allowed if neurologically stable off steroids after the RT/surgery washout and non-hemorrhagic. Untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease allowed if no immediate CNS therapy is needed, non-hemorrhagic, and neurologically stable off steroids.
Labs within 14 days: WBC >= 3,000/mcL, ANC >= 1,500/mcL, platelets >= 100,000/mcL, Hgb >= 9 g/dL, total bilirubin and creatinine <= 1.5 x ULN, AST/ALT <= 2.5 x ULN.
No history of ILD, drug-induced ILD, radiation pneumonitis requiring steroids, or active ILD.

No mean resting QTc > 470 ms (3 ECGs, Bazett), clinically important ECG rhythm or conduction abnormalities, or QT-prolongation risk factors; patients with cardiac history must be NYHA class 2B or better.
No strong CYP3A4 inducers; no investigational drug within 5 half-lives or 3 months (whichever is greater).
No unresolved prior toxicity > grade 1 (except alopecia and grade 2 platinum neuropathy), severe uncontrolled systemic disease or bleeding diathesis, or GI conditions precluding oral absorption.

HIV allowed if on effective ART with undetectable viral load within 6 months; chronic HBV requires undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy if indicated; HCV must be cured or have undetectable viral load on treatment.
Prior or concurrent malignancy allowed if it does not interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not pregnant and not nursing (pregnancy test within 14 days).

studies.title: Reaching Rural Cancer Survivors Who Smoke Using Text-Based Cessation Interventions

schema.label: Registration
schema.text: Rural cancer survivors (diagnosis within 10 years) who smoke ≥ 5 cigarettes/day and want to quit.

schema.label: Stratification
schema.text: Baseline cigarettes per day (≥ 20 vs < 20); age (≥ 65 vs < 65); sex. Pocock-Simon dynamic allocation.

arms.label: Intervention
arms.text: 8-week text-based Scheduled Gradual Reduction (Mosio system) with target quit date 8 weeks after enrollment, plus NCI Smokefree.TXT from 2 weeks before to 4 weeks after the quit date (12 weeks of intervention).

arms.label: Control
arms.text: NCI Clearing the Air cessation booklet, with a quit date set within 8 weeks.

schema.label: Assessments
schema.text: Questionnaires at baseline, 30 days, and 6 months after quit date; urine cotinine/anabasine at 6 months for those reporting abstinence.

schema.label: Primary endpoint
schema.text: Biochemically validated smoking abstinence 6 months after quit date (urine cotinine < 50 ng/mL, or anabasine < 2 ng/mL for those vaping or using NRT).

eligibility: Cancer diagnosis within the past 10 years (DCIS eligible; patients currently receiving curative treatment eligible).
Not currently on hospice.
Currently smokes ≥ 5 cigarettes daily (dual cigarette and vape users eligible; vape-only users not eligible).
Lives in a nonmetro/rural county (RUCC 4-9 and/or RUCA 4-10, or qualifying large-area low-density metro tracts with RUCA 2-3).
Interested in a smoking cessation program; not in another cessation trial or program and not using cessation pharmacotherapy (NRT, bupropion, or varenicline for smoking).
Has a cell phone or smartphone with texting.
Speaks and reads English or Spanish.
Age ≥ 18 years.
Willing to provide a urine sample.
No impaired decision-making capacity.

pretreatment.item: Self-reported county of residence, demographics, health information
Baseline questionnaires: C-TUQ, FTND, SEQ-12, motivation and intention to quit, lung cancer screening question, Alliance baseline questionnaire, LASA 6
pretreatment.window: Same day as registration, up to 21 days after

pretreatment.item: Enrollment in Mosio reduction system and Smokefree.TXT
pretreatment.note: Intervention arm only.

during.item: Adherence to SGR texts and engagement with Smokefree.TXT
during.window: Intervention period
during.note: Intervention arm.

followup.item: Questionnaires: FTND, SEQ-12, 7-day point prevalence tobacco use, cessation medication use, partial Alliance questionnaire, LASA 6
followup.window: 30 days and 6 months after quit date
followup.note: Up to 30 days after each time point; ePRO, phone, or booklet.

followup.window: 30 days after quit date only
Within 6 months of post-quit date
followup.note: Clinic visit needed only if the patient self-reports quitting.

submission.label: Rave
submission.text: 6.1.4 Supporting documentation to be submitted to the Alliance This study requires supporting documentation to verify that the patient is a smoker and has a cancer diagnosis during their eligibility review.

submission.label: Rave
submission.text: Supporting documentation will include a clinic note with patient history .
